findings.description: F-007: Debug Lab 9 was titled 'Ластик стирает половину штриха, а не весь' but its filename, code, symptom and fix are entirely about Undo (def undo(self), 'После Ctrl+Z...'). The eraser is a separate feature with its own section (18.23) and its own real limitation. In a symptom-lookup reference this actively misroutes the reader.
findings.resolution: Fixed in scripts/build_chapter_18.py (build_31): retitled 'Undo убирает только последний отрезок штриха, а не весь штрих', matching its filename, code, symptom and fix. Body unchanged. Verified: 'Ластик стирает половину' -> 0 hits; the new title is PRESENT in the regenerated page.

findings.description: F-006: Debug Lab 11's symptom panel said 'список становится отрицательной длины', which is not a real Python behaviour -- verified that del document[len(document)-len(shapes):] on an empty list raises nothing and does nothing. The real symptom is that Ctrl+Z appears to do nothing and a subsequent Ctrl+Y resurrects shapes the user deleted with 'Очистить'. The symptom panel is exactly the part the paired practice asks learners to match against.
findings.resolution: Fixed in scripts/build_chapter_18.py (build_31): the symptom now reads that Ctrl+Z does nothing visible and the next Ctrl+Y returns the shapes deleted by 'Очистить'; the explanation spells out that the slice is a silent no-op and that the stale action lands on redo_stack. The matching callout in build_26 was updated in the same pass for consistency. Verified: 'отрицательной длины' -> 0 hits in the regenerated page.

findings.description: F-011 (part): the practice card promised 'для набора описанных симптомов выбираем правильную причину/исправление', but the notebook and grader covered exactly one lab (DL11) and asked nothing to be chosen.
findings.resolution: Fixed by extending the practice: notebooks/chapter-18/18-31-debug-labs.ipynb now also reproduces Debug Lab 10 (a new action must clear redo_stack) alongside Lab 11, site/practice/graders/18-31.py was extended to five checks across both labs, and the card blurb was rewritten to name them. Re-executed rc=0 (output "['A', 'C'] []"); grader passes on correct and fails on a wrong commit_action that omits redo.clear().
